title: Apply a formula as you learn it
description: Claude builds a blank scatter right in the conversation — you place the points, drag them, watch what happens to the fit.
prompt: I'm learning linear regression and I can do the formula but I don't get it. Can you give me something where I can mess with the data points myself and watch what happens to the line? I want to actually feel why one weird point can throw the whole thing off. Can you help me visualize?
steps: Describe the task (express the gap between computing and understanding)
Give Claude context (optional lecture materials for connection to coursework)
Claude creates an interactive canvas for manipulation
Follow up with refinement prompts (request math explanations, overlay comparisons, or prediction tests)
prerequisites: Optional: problem sets or lecture slides for context
